mentions.name: EasyReader
mentions.description: Open source Swift app that lets readers circle any part of a PDF or ePub and send it to AI for an explanation. Currently integrates with Gemini, with support for user-supplied OpenAI-compatible endpoints planned. Works best on Mac and iPad and is available via TestFlight and GitHub.
